I couldn't confirm this from the search results. Three searches returned only race results for the 2008 Australian, British, Singapore and Japanese Grands Prix, and none of them mention Anthony Davidson, Super Aguri, or Takuma Sato.

From my own knowledge, Davidson drove for Super Aguri in 2008, and his teammate for the full season was Takuma Sato. Davidson joined partway through the year, replacing Sakon Yamamoto, so Sato is the likely answer. That is unverified here, though.

ANSWER: Takuma Sato
